text:
Type: crocheted fabric baskets, set of four
Use: organizing small items on shelves, desks or in drawers; home office, bedroom, living room, bathroom
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: thick crocheted cord with a ribbed stitch
Colors: dark slate grey
Shape: four open rectangular and square baskets in graduated sizes, soft upright walls with vertical crochet ribs, low and compact
Feel: soft, tidy, cozy, crafted
Goes with: light wood shelving, white walls, grey textiles; Scandinavian, minimalist or contemporary rooms

product.name: NORDRANA
product.description: Each basket is unique since they are handmade.
